score._note: Frozen before the census (label H1). Stage A uses library records only. Stage B uses probe samples for the top stage_b_k systems.

xrd._wavelength_note: D record (H1): Cu K-alpha, Bruker D8 Discover with an area detector (named default from NREL open papers with HTEM data: arXiv 2206.03594, 2306.02233; not stated in the HTEM descriptor or data record; the raw-file endpoint is not served). K-alpha1/2 unresolved on the area detector: weighted mean 1.5418 A. To be checked against a reference phase on a non-pilot library in H3 (reference-standard route).
xrd._tuning_note: H4 P1: joint multi-peak fit (dev evidence: weak peaks beside strong neighbours were pulled and deduped); grid min_snr x smooth x window on dev seeds 0-99 (tune_P1.json): 0.968 within 0.02 deg; chosen min_snr 6 (default), smooth 3, window 0.8.

optical._tuning_note: H4 P1: FAILED on dev seeds (VH-E05): Tauc window grid best bias SD 0.106 eV (gate 0.02); edge-model procedure (iteration 2) bias SD 0.29 eV; censoring never flagged. No Eg keys for P1. Default method stays tauc for P2.

fpm._geometry_note: D record (H1): custom collinear four-point probe, 1 mm pin spacing, current through the outer pins, "conventional geometric corrections" (arXiv 2206.03594, 2306.02233; Smits 1958). The exact correction is not recorded (D gap); 4.532 = pi/ln2 (infinite thin sheet) is the named default. Rs magnitudes carry this unrecorded factor; ranks are unaffected.

d_records.xrd: Bruker D8 Discover, Cu K-alpha (1.5418 A named default), area detector; 2theta range from the data (19-52 deg on most records; some 661-point patterns)
d_records.optical: home-built thin-film optical spectroscopy system, deuterium and tungsten/halogen sources, Si detector array, T and R 300-1100 nm (plus NIR channels on some records); incidence geometry not stated (D gap); absorbance A = ln[T/(1-R)]
d_records.thickness: XRF-measured (model-derived): level A. Tauc Eg is invariant to a constant thickness scale; absorption and resistivity magnitudes are not keyable
d_records.fpm: collinear four-point probe, 1 mm spacing, conventional corrections (factor not recorded; 4.532 named default)
d_records.xrf: Fischer XDV-SDD (Rh source, 3 mm spot) in 2022 papers; Bruker M4 Tornado (Rh, 25 um spot) in 2023 papers; the instrument per library is not recorded (xrf_type field)
d_records.license: NREL Data Catalog submission 75 (doi:10.7799/1407128): NREL dataset license, free use and copying provided the entire notice appears in all copies and DOE/NREL/Alliance are credited; no endorsement use. Release with the notice attached.

P1._source: dev/dev_stats_P1.json (dev library 6867, 44 samples), 5-95 % ranges; Eg from the kit optical reader on the dev library (1.98-2.34 eV) widened to 1.5-3.0

P2._source: dev/dev_stats_P2.json (dev library 10672, 44 samples; host B), 5-95 % ranges. Dev library has NIR-only optical (no UV-vis) and no electrical data: no optical or FPM ranges (VH-E06).
